usage_type.description: Can be 'limited' or 'unlimited'. In most cases, changing this will affect your monthly bill.

extension.description: Extension number that callers may dial. On POST, leaving this empty will result in an auto-generated value. On PUT, this field is required.

full_name.description: Full name of the individual or department to which this extension is assigned

name.description: User-supplied name for the extension. On POST, leaving this empty will result in an auto-generated value. On PUT, this field is required

timezone.description: Time zone in IANA time zone database format (like 'America/Los_Angeles')

name_greeting.description: Greeting that communicates the extension's name

include_in_directory.description: Whether this extension should be included in the dial-by-name directory for this account.

caller_id.description: Phone number to use as Caller ID for outgoing calls. Must be a phone number belonging to this account, or one of any additional authorized phone number

local_area_code.description: For outbound calls, this is the North American area code that this extension is calling from

enable_call_waiting.description: Whether Call Waiting is enabled. Default is TRUE

enable_outbound_calls.description: Whether outgoing calls are enabled. Default is TRUE.

bypass_hard_phone.description: Set 'true' if you want to use advanced call handling rules instead of device

password.description: Password for accessing voicemail box. Must be digits only.

type.description: The greeting to play. Can be 'name' for the name_greeting as described above, 'standard' for the standard greeting, or 'alternate' for an alternate greeting.

standard.description: Greeting to be played when type='standard'

alternate.description: Greeting to be played when type='alternate'

enable_leave_message_prompt.description: Whether to prompt the caller with the following words after the voicemail greeting has been played: 'Please leave your message after the tone. When finished, hang up or press the pound key.

transcription.description: Type of voicemail transcription to use. Can be 'human' for high-quality manual transcriptions by human operators, 'automated' for machine-generated transcriptions, or NULL to omit trancriptions

attachments.description: If notification emails are being used, this defines the format of the audio attachments. Can be 'wav' for WAV format, 'mp3' for MP3 format, or NULL to disable attachments.

sms.description: Phone number capable of receiving SMS messages

notifications.description: Voicemail Notifications Object. Can be set to NULL to disable notifications.
